summary: - (a) The Petitioners are wholly owned subsidiaries of the Respondent No.2, PowerGrid Corporation of India Limited (shortly referred to as “POWERGRID”), which has established project-based Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) through the Bid Process Coordinator after successfully participating in the bidding process. The Petitioners are engaged in a similar nature of business to that of their parent company, i.e., construction, operation, and maintenance of transmission-related assets and elements, including transmission lines and substations, spread over various parts of the country. - (d) The Petitioners have submitted the details of the Transferee Companies (Petitioner **3.** The Petitioners were heard by the Commission on 20.7.2026, 10.9.2026 and 6.11.2026 **.** The counsel for the Petitioners submitted that notice under Section 17(2) of the Act was issued on 21.5.2026 to every other licensee who transmits or distributes in the relevant areas, and the No Objection Certificate had also been received from the Respondent No.1, CTUIL, on 26.5.2026 in respect of the proposed merger. In response to the queries raised by the Commission vide record of proceedings dated 10.9.2026, the petitioner has made submission vide affidavit dated 1.10.2026. On 6.11.2026, the counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the Regional Director (RD), Northern Region, New Delhi, has approved the Scheme of Merger under the fast-track merger route. The Commission directed the Petitioners to place on record the approval granted by the RD, along with the approved Scheme of Merger and related documents within a week. The matter was reserved for order. It is noted that none of the Respondents has filed its reply to the Petition. **4.** We have considered the submissions of the Petitioners. The Petitioner has filed this Petition invoking the sub-sections (1) and (3) of Section 17 of the Act seeking the approval of the Commission for the amalgamation or merger of Petitioner Nos. 1 to 17 (Transferor Companies) with Petitioner No.18 (Transferee Company) pursuant to the Scheme of Arrangement under Sections 230-233 of the Companies Act. It entails the assignment or transfer of the transmission licences of the Transferor Companies granted by this Commission in favour of the Transferee Company. The scope of the present case is to check whether the proposed merger is within the meaning of Section 17(1)(b) of the Act, whether the transaction involves transfer or assignment of a licence or regulated utility under Section 17(3) of the Act, amendment in the existing licence conditions under Section 18, effects of merger on the tariff already determined by the Commission and effect on the interests of other licensees and stakeholders, including the notice requirement under Section 17(2) of the Act. **5.** The Petitioners have prayed for the approval of the Commission under subsections (1) and (3) of Section 17 of the Act. Let us examine the scope of Section 17 of the Act, which reads as under: “Section 17 of the Electricity Act (i.e., the relevant provision in context of the present Petition) provides as follows: **7.** We have examined whether the proposed scheme of merger as submitted by the Petitioners involves a merger or transfer of their respective assets within the meaning of Section 17(1)(b) of the Act or it is the merger of the corporate identities without transfer of assets. It is necessary to examine the transaction under the proposed scheme and the manner in which such assets, rights, obligations and functions are proposed to be transferred or merged with another entity. **8.** We have perused the submission of the Petitioner with regard to the transactions under the proposed scheme. According to the Petitioner, the scheme sanction by the MCA under the provisions of Sections 230 to 233 and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, after the Effective Date, but with effect from the Appointed Date, the Business Undertakings shall stand transferred to and vest in Petitioner No. 18. Transferee Company, as a going concern, together with all the respective estates, properties, assets, contracts, employees, records, approvals (including Governmental Approvals), rights, claims, title and authorities, benefits, liabilities and interest therein, subject to existing charges thereon in favour of banks and financial institutions or otherwise, as the case may be, without any further act, instrument, deed, matter or thing being made, done or executed, so as to become, as and from the Appointed Date, the estate, properties, assets, rights, claims, entitlements, title and authorities, benefits, liabilities and interest of the Transferee Company by virtue of and in the manner provided in the Scheme. Upon the Scheme becoming effective, each of the Transferor Companies shall be dissolved without being wound up, without any further act or deed. Corporation of India Ltd’s Tariff based competitive bidding based business u/s 63 of the Act distinct from its Regulated tariff mechanism business u/s 62 of the Act; and (ii) reduction in the number of companies within the group as well as achieving reduction multiplicity of legal and regulatory compliances. It is noted that the proposed consolidation is for ease of business operation, without affecting the tariff, nature and operation of the transmission assets, or affecting the interests of the stakeholders. We find that the Petitioners have complied with the requirements stipulated under the Act and TSA regarding amalgamation or merger of Petitioner No. 1 to Petitioner No. 17 with Petitioner No. 18 pursuant to the Scheme of Arrangement under Sections 230233 of the Companies Act, 2013.
title: Petition under Section 17(1) and 17(3) of the Electricity Act, 2003 for amalgamation/merger of Powergrid Kudankulam Transmission Limited, Powergrid Barmer I Transmission Limited, Powergrid Bikaner IV Transmission Limited, Powergrid Siwani Transmission Limited, Powergrid Fatehgarh Barmer Augmentation Transmission Limited, Powergrid Ramgarh Transmission Limited, Powergrid Bhadla Transmission Limited, Powergrid Fatehgarh Transmission Limited, Powergrid Bikaner Transmission System Limited, Powergrid Narela Transmission Limited, Powergrid Khetri Transmission System Limited, Powergrid Ajmer Phagi Transmission Limited, Powergrid Varanasi Transmission System Limited, Powergrid Neemuch Transmission System Limited, Powergrid Mithilanchal Transmission Limited, Powergrid Medinipur Jeerat Transmission Limited and Powergrid Mahan Rewa Transmission Limited with Powergrid Ghiror Transmission Limited, and assignment/transfer of transmission licences pursuant to such amalgamation/merger. 1. PowerGrid Kundankulam Transmission Limited, 2. PowerGrid Barmer I Transmission Limited and Ors.
